$comment: Waivers for Supabase database advisor findings (supabase db advisors, run by the pgTAP job after supabase start) that scripts/ci/supabaseAdvisors.mjs would otherwise block. Each entry: lint (the advisor's lint name), findings (the advisor's cacheKey for each finding it covers: one per policy, per table/role/action, or per function body, so a new policy or a changed function is a new finding), reason (at least 40 characters: why it is acceptable here), expires (null: accepted by design; YYYY-MM-DD, at most 180 days out: debt to fix). An expired or invalid waiver covers nothing; a waived finding the advisors no longer report fails the gate. See docs/operations/ci-cd.md ("Supabase advisors").

waivers.reason: public.min(uuid) is an aggregate (20260612000000), which cannot carry SET search_path; its support function min_uuid pins search_path = public. public.set_updated_at() is a trigger function that calls only now(), which resolves from pg_catalog before any search_path entry; a from-scratch build creates it (20251217000000) but production has none (schema drift, recorded in the plan).

findings: auth_rls_init_plan_public_import_jobs_Users can view their organization's import jobs
waivers.reason: Debt: these policies call auth.uid() or current_setting() per row instead of once through (select auth.uid()). A performance cost at scale, not an access defect. Rewriting RLS policies is a security-surface change for its own reviewed pull request (plan rule 14), not part of adding the gate (M3.3).

Debt: each table has a member SELECT policy and an admin ALL policy, both permissive for authenticated, so SELECT evaluates both. A performance cost, not an access defect (permissive policies OR together either way). Merging them is an RLS change for its own reviewed pull request, not part of adding the gate (M3.3).
